title: Meowth

description.en: Local bridge for five coding-agent CLIs with HTTP control and a web dashboard
description.zh: 把五种本机编程 Agent CLI 接入统一 HTTP 服务，并提供网页管理面板。

subject: Multicolored faceted kitten with a bow tie and paw-print accents

source.description: Local bridge for five coding-agent CLIs with HTTP control and a web dashboard

subject.en: A silver-blue American Shorthair head playing with one yarn loop
subject.zh: 拨弄一圈彩色毛线的银蓝美短猫头像

title.en: A tilted head and a waiting paw

description.en: The American Shorthair tilts its large head toward a single yarn strand held by one natural paw. Unequal ear heights and the loop beside the cheek establish the offset moment. The complete faceted shoulder contour is uniformly inset with generous room around ears, whiskers and yarn.
description.zh: 美短把大脑袋歪向一根毛线，一只自然的小爪轻轻按住它。高低错落的双耳与脸旁线圈形成偏心瞬间，完整的肩部色块轮廓等比内收，为耳尖、胡须和毛线留出空间。

description.en: Silver, slate blue and warm ivory form the classic tabby markings through connected flat facets. Amber eyes keep the expression clear. Coral, gold, turquoise and violet stay together along one continuous yarn strand instead of spreading across the coat.
description.zh: 银灰、石板蓝和暖象牙白以连贯的平面碎片构成经典虎斑，琥珀眼保持神态清楚。珊瑚、金、青与紫集中在一根连续毛线上，不散落到毛色中。

description.en: Muted mauve paper carries broad looping relief in the empty corners, echoing the yarn’s action at lower contrast. Fine grain, broad light and shallow contact shadows add depth while keeping the silver portrait distinct from the background.
description.zh: 柔和灰紫纸面在角落留白处铺开宽阔回环，以较低对比呼应毛线动作。细颗粒、宽柔光和浅接触阴影增加层次，让银灰头像与背景清楚分开。

palette.source: Selected local presentation, meowth/2026-09-07-01/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 32/16 px the tilted ears, silver tabby mask and amber eyes carry recognition. Fine whiskers and the two bends of the single yarn strand simplify. Sidebar and favicon marks use the transparent cat; large views may use the mauve presentation.
sizeNote.zh: 32/16 px 主要通过歪斜的双耳、银灰虎斑脸与琥珀眼识别；细胡须和同一根毛线的两个弯折会简化。侧栏和 favicon 使用透明猫咪，大图可使用灰紫色底纹展示。

goal.en: Run locally installed coding CLIs through one web console and HTTP API, with streaming output and a record of their sessions.
goal.zh: 通过同一个网页控制台与 HTTP 接口调用本机 coding CLI，查看流式输出并保存会话记录。

role.en: Daemon, HTTP API and CLI subprocesses
role.zh: daemon、HTTP 接口与 CLI 子进程

description.en: One broad yarn loop and a short returning line echo the cat’s single playful gesture.
description.zh: 一道宽松毛线环与短回线，呼应猫咪拨弄毛线的那个小动作。

alt.zh: 拨弄一圈彩色毛线的银蓝美短猫头像，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 把不同智能体，接到一起。

description.en: Silver-blue American Shorthair head playing with one yarn loop.
description.zh: 拨弄一圈彩色毛线的银蓝美短猫头像。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥97px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 97px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
